1.

Hear, the blessed throng of millions Sing the Lamb’s praise, oh hear! Thousands upon thousands answer, Like an echo that ne’er will die.

2.

“Praise the Lamb!” thus they are singing, The song fills heaven’s expanse; High and wide, each tongue is raising Praise to the gospel’s advance.

3.

That same song of praise there sounding, Eternal ‘round the Father’s throne, The Lamb His offering is bringing In full, harmonious, united tone.

4.

All to the Son homage render, Even as to the Father’s name; Seen in the Son’s own brightness tender, The Father’s glory stands proclaim’d.

5.

By God’s Holy Spirit learning, Saints perceive that Jesus bears All divine power and glory turning, He who ever is and was and there.

6.

Hear those wondrous tones ascending, How they praise Him there on high! “Amen!” heaven’s heights are sending, “Amen!” earth’s deep valleys cry.
